resources.string: Needs a shell; the firmware\'s own apps lose the wheel keys meanwhile
Add JMCAR to the sleep whitelist of the unit (its BootControl app, or the ROM mod settings). Otherwise the firmware stops it when the ignition goes off.
The MediaTek background saver stops JMCAR at ignition off. JMCAR turns it off itself, at each boot, once it may write secure settings.
In the factory settings of the unit. The unit then starts normally instead of killing apps before its fast sleep.
The firmware keeps three lists of apps allowed to start, run behind and survive the sleep. JMCAR adds itself to them with root.
